question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Chastise
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flog**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Chastise"** means to criticize or reprimand someone severely or to punish, especially by beating. (डांटना या दंड देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher chastised the student for being late to class.
 
 
 
• **"Flog"** refers to beating someone with a whip or stick as a form of punishment. It is a synonym of "chastise" when chastise is used in the context of physical punishment. (कोड़े मारना)
 
 
• **Example:** The prisoner was flogged for breaking the rules.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Flog" is the most appropriate synonym for "Chastise."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Flog**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Compliment** (प्रशंसा करना): To express praise or admiration for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She complimented him on his excellent presentation skills.
 
 
 
• **Laud** (प्रशंसा करना): To praise someone or something highly, especially in a public context.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist was lauded for her groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **Praise** (प्रशंसा): To express warm approval or admiration of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The parents praised their child for scoring well in exams.
